scene_description: Three children are sitting at a table doing a craft activity. The girl in the front is wearing a teal shirt and holding a decorated round object with scissors. Two other children are behind her, also working on crafts. The table has papers, markers, and craft supplies on it.

questions.question: What is the girl holding?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the girl in the teal shirt has in her hands.

questions.question: What tool is the girl using?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the girl's right hand near the craft ball.

questions.question: Who is sitting at the table?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people sitting around the table.

questions.question: Where are the children sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is underneath all the craft supplies.

questions.question: What color is the girl's shirt?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the shirt the girl in front is wearing.
